name: play-designer
description: Lehi special teams play designer. The PAGES have no dependencies and no build step -- that is why they work on a phone on a practice field with no signal, and it is not negotiable. This file exists for the serverless functions in api/ only.
//: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, since the repo deliberately did not have one.
api/save-playbook.js and api/feedback.js use nothing but global fetch. The
hub's data layer cannot: its whole security model is BEGIN, set local role,
bind four transaction-local GUCs, run, COMMIT -- one transaction on one
connection. An HTTP-per-statement driver cannot express that, and losing it
means losing the isolation that 1,308 tests exist to prove.
So: one dependency, pg, for api/ only.
THERE IS NO BUILD SCRIPT, ON PURPOSE. Vercel serves this repo as a static
site plus functions. A `build` script here would make it try to build the
site, and the site is index.html. If a build ever becomes necessary, the
static pages must keep working without it.
